title: Product of monomials under symmetric difference
statement: Let $q,n$ be natural numbers, let $S_0,\ldots,S_{q-1}$ be subsets of the $n$ coordinates, and let $x$ be a sign vector on those coordinates. The product of the monomials indexed by the sets $S_j$, evaluated at $x$, equals the monomial indexed by their iterated symmetric difference, evaluated at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: q and n are natural numbers
sets is a q-indexed family of subsets of the n coordinates
x is a sign vector on n coordinates
